This lesson skips the machines and covers GTSR's under-the-hood mixin tweaks — no new blocks, just quality-of-life.

Sneak right-click a boiler controller with an empty hand to §2decalc it on the spot§r; a screwdriver gives input hatches and input busses §6auto-input§r (fed from the inventory in front) and toggles their filters; steam input busses accept direct pipe extraction, steam output busses learned auto-output; GT5U's own steam multiblocks now take cooling hatches; and the redstone hatch fits any multiblock (up to four per machine), emitting a signal that tracks progress.

§8§oNot a single new machine — yet you will meet them everywhere.§r
